name: list_orders
description: List a customer's orders, newest first, as summaries. The response is paginated at 20 orders per page: total_matches gives the full count and next_cursor is non-null while pages remain. Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the following page.

status.description: Return only orders in this state.

since.description: Return only orders placed at or after this moment, as an ISO-8601 instant with a UTC offset, for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

cursor.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call. Omit for the first page.

error_returns.when: since is not an ISO-8601 instant with an offset.
